experiment: GW2 — rotating quanta carried on the VP scaffold: speed, transparency of quanta-empty regions, polarization content
status: pre-registered before running gw2_run.py; no exploratory run was made
principle: Everything comes from the lattice. VP (the medium) is never empty and carries c^2 = B/rho; quanta (rotating units) ride on it and may be absent. Observation first: gravitational waves travel at c and are tensor-polarized (+, x); light is transverse with two polarizations.

model.reduction: 3-D reduced to the ray (x) plus a transverse observer ring; allowed by the corpus rule that excessive computation may be reduced
model.scaffold: 1-D chain along the ray, mass m, spring k, spacing a (m=k=a=1, so c_L=1). Always full (VP).
model.quanta: rigid rotors spinning about the ray axis at occupied sites, inertia I, coupled to the local scaffold strain eps_n by V = 1/2 kappa (theta_n - g eps_n)^2. Occupancy mask: a gap of empty sites in mid-chain.
model.lagrangian: T = sum 1/2 m udot^2 + sum_occ 1/2 I thetadot^2 ; V = sum 1/2 k eps^2 + sum_occ 1/2 kappa (theta - g eps)^2 ; full two-way coupling (the rotors load the scaffold)
model.multipoles: each quantum carries a body-fixed transverse dipole (helicity-1 test) or a traceless quadrupole (helicity-2 test); a ring of M test points around the ray reads their field change

setup.pulse: Gaussian displacement, width w=20 a, launched right-moving from rest (d'Alembert)

regimes.slaved: rotor frequency sqrt(kappa/I) = 10 x pulse frequency c_L/w

setup.probes: sites 1500, 2500 (before gap), 3300 (in gap: scaffold only), 4200, 5200 (after gap)

predictions.P1_c_maintained: scaffold strain-peak speed is c_L within 1% before, inside and after the quanta-empty gap (slaved regime)
predictions.P2_carried: slaved regime: the rotation pattern theta travels at c_L within 1% before the gap and reappears after the gap on schedule (arrival-time speed within 1% of c_L)
predictions.P3_condition: heavy regime: the rotation pattern lags or disperses, speed deviating from c_L by more than 1% (carrying requires fast internal rotation)
predictions.P4_polarization: ring readout: quadrupole quanta give monopole (breathing) fraction < 1e-10 and quadrupole fraction > 0.99, with two independent states 45 degrees apart (+, x); dipole quanta give a helicity-1 pattern with two states 90 degrees apart
